description: One-way ANOVA to test whether a numeric outcome differs significantly across groups, with Tukey HSD post-hoc pairwise comparisons and eta-squared effect size. Use to compare test scores across course sections, salary equity across departments, or satisfaction ratings across demographic groups.

metric_column.description: Numeric outcome column to compare across groups

group_column.description: Categorical column defining the groups (e.g. department, section, cohort)
